Class PassiveRoundPhaseHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.PassiveRoundPhaseHandler
public class PassiveRoundPhaseHandler extends Object
Advances the automatic phases of a round.

Most game phases are driven by a player command. For example, moveTotem, chooseCard, and extraDrawn are explicit actions received from a client.

Some phases are different: they do not require another player command. Once the game reaches one of those phases, the model can continue by itself. Those automatic phases are:

  • RoundPhase.RESOLVING_EFFECTS;
  • RoundPhase.RESETTING_BOARD;
  • RoundPhase.FINAL_SCORING.

This handler owns only that passive progression. It changes model state and marks the game as changed, but it does not notify listeners. Listener notification belongs to GameActionExecutor, which wraps the whole public action and sends one final payload if the state version changed.

  • Method Details

    • advancePassivePhases

      public void advancePassivePhases()
      Keeps advancing the game while the current phase is automatic.

      The method stops as soon as the game reaches a phase that requires a player command. For example, after resetting the board, the game returns to RoundPhase.PLACING_TOTEMS; at that point the next player must actively choose a totem space, so this method stops.

      This method is called after public game actions such as chooseCard, extraDrawn, and disconnection handling. Those actions only need to move the round into an automatic phase; this handler then performs the automatic chain until a player-driven phase is reached.
